task.title: Look around
task.shortdesc: See what the places in the list on the left and the search box do for the person you added.

context.p: The list down the left side of the screen shows the main places. Most of them show the person you are looking at.

info.p: It shows that person's page. With the iPad on its side, the family tree of that person is beside the page.
It lists what happened in that person's life, such as a birth. Each one is a fact.
It draws a tree of that person, with parents above and children below.
It lists and some other places. They are for later.

step.cmd: Choose , type a few letters of a name in the search box, then choose .

info.p: Choose a card in the results to open that person.

result.p: To go back one screen, choose the back arrow at the top left.
